construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.

City of San Jose permit H25-021 (Site Development Permit/Amendment, folder year 2025), status Approved, issue date 2026-03-25: "Site development permit to allow the construction of eight residential condominium units on separate lots and four condominium units on two lots, subject to the State Density Bonus Law, including the demolition of a single-family home and the removal of 2" (city text cut off at 255 characters)

City of San Jose permit PRE25-282 (Prelim - Focused (Policy Review, No Plans), folder year 2025), status Complete: "SB 330 Preliminary Application for demolition of an existing single-family home and the construction of 12 residential condominium units."
City of San Jose permit T25-017 (Tentative Map, folder year 2025), status Approved: "Tentative Map to subdivide for 12 condominiums"

CEQA Notice of Exemption (Class 32 infill, CEQA Guidelines 15332), received 2026-08-21: 12 condominium units, 8 on separate lots and 4 on two lots; one density bonus incentive to allow a two-family dwelling use; fourteen waivers covering height, number of stories, floor area ratio, common and private open space, tree canopy coverage, parking, building entrances and lot depth ratio; demolition of one single-family home and removal of 21 trees. Applicant: Cyrus Jahanian, City Connect Partners, Inc., 1018 Lincoln Avenue, San Jose. Lead agency contact: Cort Hitchens, Supervising Planner.

City of San Jose permit TR22-126 (2022-04-18, Approved): dead tree removal of one California incense cedar from the front yard of a 0.70-gross-acre single-family lot; applicant and owner listed as Dombro Stephen N and Janet F.
City Connect describes itself as a real estate development, construction and property management company founded in 2021; its site does not list this project.
